sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: It is the most reviled form of contemporary architecture there is.
sentences.zh: 这是当代建筑中最令人厌恶的一种形式。

sentences.en: A McMansion is an oversized house, usually over 3,000 square feet,
sentences.zh: “麦克豪宅”（McMansion）是一种超大型住宅，通常超过3000平方英尺，

sentences.en: that doesn't really interact with its environment,
sentences.zh: 它与周围环境并没有真正的互动，

sentences.en: whether that's the houses around it or if it's built in the middle of nowhere, that environment as well.
sentences.zh: 无论是周围的邻居，还是建在荒郊野外，它与环境都格格不入。

sentences.en: This is Kate Wagner, creator of the blog McMansion Hell,
sentences.zh: 这位是凯特·瓦格纳，博客“麦克豪宅地狱”的创作者，

sentences.en: where she helps readers like me understand what is and isn't a McMansion.
sentences.zh: 她通过博客帮助像我这样的读者理解什么是麦克豪宅，什么不是。

sentences.en: And why we hate them.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么我们讨厌它们。

sentences.en: The main signs of a McMansion are that they're built cheaply with very cheap materials,
sentences.zh: 麦克豪宅的主要特征是建造廉价，使用非常廉价的材料，

sentences.en: new materials, rarely ever traditional materials.
sentences.zh: 都是新材料，几乎从不使用传统材料。

sentences.en: As you can tell by the name of the blog and by her general demeanor, Kate Wagner hates the McMansion.
sentences.zh: 正如博客名称和她的一贯态度所表现的那样，凯特·瓦格纳讨厌麦克豪宅。

sentences.en: They're built without any sort of consideration for the grammar of design.
sentences.zh: 它们的建造完全不考虑设计语法。

sentences.en: Since the creation of this show, I've used the word architecture
sentences.zh: 自本节目开播以来，我一直以最牵强、最隐喻的方式

sentences.en: in the most tenuous and metaphorical of ways.
sentences.zh: 使用“建筑”这个词。

sentences.en: But according to Kate, the McMansion may not even qualify as architecture at all.
sentences.zh: 但据凯特所说，麦克豪宅甚至根本算不上建筑。

sentences.en: There's no real architecture in the McMansion,
sentences.zh: 麦克豪宅里没有真正的建筑设计，

sentences.en: and it's too ostentatious to be considered folk architecture.
sentences.zh: 而且它太浮夸了，不能被视为民间建筑。

sentences.en: They have no architectural commentary.
sentences.zh: 它们没有任何建筑学上的表达。

sentences.en: All they do is represent sort of an ideal of wealth.
sentences.zh: 它们所做的只是代表了一种财富的理想。

sentences.en: But it's more an image of wealth rather than wealth itself.
sentences.zh: 但这更多是一种财富的形象，而非财富本身。

sentences.en: It's very much meant to convey that one message that I have a lot of money and a lot of space.
sentences.zh: 它非常刻意地传达一个信息：我有很多钱，也有很大的空间。

sentences.en: And I am putting it in this house that is so tall and so massive that you feel intimidated by it
sentences.zh: 我把它放在这栋又高又大的房子里，让你感到被它震慑，

sentences.en: just as you should feel intimidated by my apparent wealth.
sentences.zh: 就像你应该被我显而易见的财富所震慑一样。

sentences.en: That single purpose, to convey wealth,
sentences.zh: 那个单一的目的，即传达财富，

sentences.en: steamrolls every other potential design principle like symmetry or logic, history or beauty.
sentences.zh: 碾压了所有其他潜在的设计原则，如对称或逻辑、历史或美感。

sentences.en: Yeah, who cares if you have a big house if it's like so ugly?
sentences.zh: 是啊，如果房子这么丑，住大房子又有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: I don't want to look at it.
sentences.zh: 我根本不想看它。

sentences.en: Kate believes the source of this ugliness stems from the combination of mass production and customization.
sentences.zh: 凯特认为这种丑陋的根源在于大规模生产与定制化的结合。

sentences.en: During the 90s and 2000s, thanks to easy access to a lot of money through bad mortgages pushed on the American people,
sentences.zh: 在90年代和2000年代，由于向美国民众推销的不良抵押贷款使得获取资金变得容易，

sentences.en: the tastes of the new home buyer ran to the extreme.
sentences.zh: 新购房者的品味变得极端化。

sentences.en: The standard models of these mass-produced homes reflected that.
sentences.zh: 这些大规模生产住宅的标准模型反映了这一点。

sentences.en: But if grand entrances and granite countertops and stainless steel appliances weren't nice enough,
sentences.zh: 但如果宏伟的入口、花岗岩台面和不锈钢电器还不够好，

sentences.en: many new home manufacturers allowed for customizations that brought the opulence to the next level.
sentences.zh: 许多新住宅制造商允许进行定制，将奢华程度提升到了一个新的水平。

sentences.en: So they'll combine the two, an already designed prototype, with sort of a custom home,
sentences.zh: 所以他们会把两者结合起来，将已经设计好的原型与某种定制住宅结合，

sentences.en: which can end up in some pretty wild-looking results.
sentences.zh: 这最终可能会产生一些看起来非常狂野的结果。

sentences.en: So they're designed and customized from the inside out,
sentences.zh: 所以它们是从内到外设计和定制的，

sentences.en: and it makes the outside big and weird and lumpy.
sentences.zh: 这使得外观变得又大、又怪、又臃肿。

sentences.en: Because somebody wanted cathedral ceilings in their bathroom, which is obviously a necessity.
sentences.zh: 因为有人想在浴室里装大教堂式吊顶，这显然是必需品。

sentences.en: The first victim in the design-from-the-inside-out process is the roof.
sentences.zh: 这种“从内到外”设计过程的第一个受害者就是屋顶。

sentences.en: McMansion roofs are a mess.
sentences.zh: 麦克豪宅的屋顶简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: The roof is sort of the number one way to tell a McMansion from a mansion,
sentences.zh: 屋顶是区分麦克豪宅和真正豪宅的首要方式，

sentences.en: in that the roof kind of makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 因为屋顶的设计完全不合逻辑。

sentences.en: It's got various pitches, which is how sort of steep the roof is,
sentences.zh: 它有各种坡度，也就是屋顶的陡峭程度，

sentences.en: and it's got many different shapes, many different heights, many different angles.
sentences.zh: 还有许多不同的形状、高度和角度。

sentences.en: Like a gabled roof with a hipped roof, the pyramidal roof.
sentences.zh: 比如人字顶配上四坡顶，还有金字塔顶。

sentences.en: You don't really need to know what these look like, but just know they're not usually all together.
sentences.zh: 你不需要知道这些具体长什么样，只要知道它们通常不会组合在一起就行。

sentences.en: They're really just there to put a hat on a ridiculously crafted house.
sentences.zh: 它们的存在只是为了给一栋设计荒谬的房子戴上一顶帽子。

sentences.en: But the coup de grace of the McMansion roof is a feature that Kate has dubbed the McMansion nub.
sentences.zh: 但麦克豪宅屋顶的“绝杀”是一个被凯特戏称为“麦克豪宅凸起”的特征。

sentences.en: The McMansion nub is where you'll see, like, a roofline that is relatively organized,
sentences.zh: “麦克豪宅凸起”是指你会看到一个相对规整的屋顶线条，

sentences.en: and then you'll just have, like, this bump at the top because somebody had to have some feature,
sentences.zh: 然后顶部突然冒出一个凸起，因为有人非要加个什么功能，

sentences.en: and they just, like, couldn't fit it in linearly.
sentences.zh: 却又无法将其线性地整合进去。

sentences.en: Usually it's, like, either storage space or, like, someone wanted some ridiculous ceilings or ceiling feature.
sentences.zh: 通常是因为储物空间，或者有人想要某种荒谬的天花板或吊顶装饰。

sentences.en: So they just have this, like, nub at the top.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就在顶部加了这么个凸起。

sentences.en: So it's like a hat to a hat, if you will.
sentences.zh: 可以说，这就是给帽子又戴了一顶帽子。

sentences.en: According to Kate, another hallmark of the McMansion is the two-story entrance.
sentences.zh: 据凯特所说，麦克豪宅的另一个标志是两层楼高的入口。

sentences.en: You walk into a house and there's suddenly, wow, so much space.
sentences.zh: 你走进房子，突然发现，哇，空间好大。

sentences.en: Wow, look at our chandelier.
sentences.zh: 哇，看我们的吊灯。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So dramatic.
sentences.zh: 太戏剧化了。

sentences.en: That was the word that they used, is dramatic.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们用的词，戏剧化。

sentences.en: They being the real estate brokers and marketers and hosts of house-flipping TV shows.
sentences.zh: 他们指的是房地产经纪人、营销人员和房屋翻新电视节目的主持人。

sentences.en: So to have a big entryway, you should probably have a pretty big door.
sentences.zh: 所以要有一个大的入口，你可能应该有一扇足够大的门。

sentences.en: And then on top of that really big door, there's a really big window.
sentences.zh: 然后在那个大门之上，还有一个巨大的窗户。

sentences.en: Sometimes there's, like, three foot of useless space and then the really big window.
sentences.zh: 有时会有三英尺左右的无用空间，然后才是那个巨大的窗户。

sentences.en: The window usually has a square bottom to match the top of the door and an arched top.
sentences.zh: 窗户通常底部是方的，以匹配门顶，顶部则是拱形的。

sentences.en: That kind of window shape didn't even exist, really, before the McMansion.
sentences.zh: 那种窗户形状在麦克豪宅出现之前根本就不存在。

sentences.en: The McMansion invented that window.
sentences.zh: 麦克豪宅发明了那种窗户。

sentences.en: It's not only the window on top of the door that makes Kate and the avid readers of McMansion Hell cringe.
sentences.zh: 不仅是门上的窗户让凯特和“麦克豪宅地狱”的忠实读者感到尴尬。

sentences.en: It's all the windows.
sentences.zh: 而是所有的窗户。

sentences.en: And I do mean all of the windows.
sentences.zh: 我是说所有的窗户。

sentences.en: There's usually more than three different shapes of windows.
sentences.zh: 通常会有超过三种不同形状的窗户。

sentences.en: Of course, there are always thoughtful and interesting violations of any design guidelines.
sentences.zh: 当然，任何设计准则中总会有深思熟虑且有趣的违规行为。

sentences.en: But generally, Kate thinks a house should limit the front facade to two or fewer window shapes,
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，凯特认为房子应该将正面立面的窗户形状限制在两种或以下，

sentences.en: while keeping a single window style across the entirety of a single story.
sentences.zh: 同时在同一楼层保持单一的窗户风格。

sentences.en: I get ridiculous houses in my inbox all the time,
sentences.zh: 我的收件箱里总是收到各种荒谬的房子，

sentences.en: where there's, like, six different types of windows from six different architectural styles.
sentences.zh: 里面有来自六种不同建筑风格的六种不同类型的窗户。

sentences.en: It's sort of a garbled communication of sorts.
sentences.zh: 这简直是一种乱码般的交流。

sentences.en: You can't filter the signal from the noise, design-wise.
sentences.zh: 从设计角度来看，你无法从噪音中过滤出信号。

sentences.en: And last but not least, you can't have a big, ostentatious house without columns.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，没有柱子就造不出宏伟浮夸的房子。

sentences.en: So the columns usually are either oversized or undersized.
sentences.zh: 所以柱子通常要么太大，要么太小。

sentences.en: Or sometimes the columns are not columns at all.
sentences.zh: 或者有时这些柱子根本就不是柱子。

sentences.en: They're just column-shaped protrusions from the exterior wall.
sentences.zh: 它们只是外墙上柱子形状的凸起。

sentences.en: Basically, a column is created to sort of balance whatever it is that it's holding up.
sentences.zh: 基本上，柱子的存在是为了平衡它所支撑的东西。

sentences.en: That's the point of columns, is that they hold things up.
sentences.zh: 这就是柱子的意义，它们用来支撑东西。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: A lot of people seem to have not understood that in the last 30 years.
sentences.zh: 过去30年里，很多人似乎都没明白这一点。

sentences.en: But they actually are supposed to hold things up.
sentences.zh: 但它们确实应该起到支撑作用。

sentences.en: And so if you have these really big columns,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有这些非常大的柱子，

sentences.en: and they're holding up the tiniest little pediment or portico,
sentences.zh: 却只支撑着一个极小的三角楣或门廊，

sentences.en: then it looks, like, pretty ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 那看起来就非常荒谬。

sentences.en: But the point is, is that you have the really big columns,
sentences.zh: 但重点是，你有了非常大的柱子，

sentences.en: so everyone knows that you're rich like a bank that also has really big columns.
sentences.zh: 这样每个人都知道你很有钱，就像那些也有大柱子的银行一样。

sentences.en: All right, so this kind of snarky criticism is fun and all.
sentences.zh: 好了，这种尖酸刻薄的批评很有趣。

sentences.en: It's really fun for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说真的很有趣。

sentences.en: But there's a larger point to be made about the design of the McMansion.
sentences.zh: 但关于麦克豪宅的设计，还有一个更宏大的观点。

sentences.en: According to Kate, the age of the McMansion saw the shift of the house
sentences.zh: 据凯特所说，麦克豪宅时代见证了房屋的转变，

sentences.en: from a place that we live in, potentially for the rest of our lives,
sentences.zh: 从我们可能居住一辈子的家，

sentences.en: to an asset that we are decidedly not supposed to live in forever.
sentences.zh: 变成了我们注定不会永远居住的资产。

sentences.en: People started designing their houses with the notion of selling them in mind.
sentences.zh: 人们开始在设计房子时就考虑将其卖掉。

sentences.en: Realtors would advise, oh, I wouldn't buy or do this,
sentences.zh: 房地产经纪人会建议，哦，我不会买这个或做这个，

sentences.en: because then the house isn't going to sell very well.
sentences.zh: 因为那样房子就不好卖了。

sentences.en: So we sort of devised this culture where we thought about selling our houses
sentences.zh: 所以我们形成了一种文化，我们在还没住上一晚之前，

sentences.en: before we even spent one night in them.
sentences.zh: 就已经在考虑卖掉房子了。

sentences.en: Kate lays the blame for this mindset at the feet of HGTV and similar channels.
sentences.zh: 凯特将这种心态归咎于HGTV等类似频道。

sentences.en: The excess and conformity of the McMansion was reinforced over and over again
sentences.zh: 麦克豪宅的过度和从众心理在房屋装修和翻新电视节目中

sentences.en: on home improvement and house-flipping TV shows,
sentences.zh: 被反复强化，

sentences.en: because the house as object could always be improved,
sentences.zh: 因为房子作为一种商品总是可以被“改进”，

sentences.en: not necessarily to make it better,
sentences.zh: 不一定是为了让它更好，

sentences.en: but to make it sell.
sentences.zh: 而是为了让它更好卖。

sentences.en: Home improvement channels would paint a house beige,
sentences.zh: 家居装修频道会把房子漆成米色，

sentences.en: and then you would see this ticker in the corner that says,
sentences.zh: 然后你会看到角落里有个滚动条写着，

sentences.en: oh, we just added $800 to the value of this house, or something like that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们刚刚为这栋房子增加了800美元的价值，诸如此类。

sentences.en: They would come up with these crazy ways to quantify these sort of improvements
sentences.zh: 他们会想出各种疯狂的方法来量化这些所谓的改进，

sentences.en: that sort of cause people to go into these frenzies,
sentences.zh: 这导致人们陷入疯狂，

sentences.en: and that's why so many houses look the same,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这么多房子看起来都一样，

sentences.en: is because this is what was told would make our house worth more,
sentences.zh: 因为有人告诉我们这样做会让房子更值钱，

sentences.en: rather than what actually does make a house worth more,
sentences.zh: 而不是真正能让房子增值的东西，

sentences.en: which is structural changes, improving energy efficiency,
sentences.zh: 比如结构性改造、提高能源效率、

sentences.en: green upgrades, things like that.
sentences.zh: 绿色升级之类的东西。

sentences.en: Not like adding a certain color of paint.
sentences.zh: 而不是涂某种颜色的油漆。

sentences.en: It's totally subjective.
sentences.zh: 这完全是主观的。

sentences.en: Older McMansions built in the early 2000s are not proving to be a very good investment.
sentences.zh: 2000年代初建造的旧麦克豪宅并没有证明是很好的投资。

sentences.en: Smaller houses are appreciating at a much faster rate than larger houses.
sentences.zh: 小型住宅的升值速度比大型住宅快得多。

sentences.en: But after a lull in the market following the housing crisis,
sentences.zh: 但在住房危机后的市场低迷之后，

sentences.en: builders are finding buyers for huge, brand new homes again.
sentences.zh: 建筑商又开始为巨大的全新住宅找到买家了。

sentences.en: According to CBS News,
sentences.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，

sentences.en: It's safe to assume that all the bad design choices in the first round of McMansions
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，第一轮麦克豪宅中所有的糟糕设计选择

sentences.en: will continue on in this new generation,
sentences.zh: 都将延续到这一代新房中，

sentences.en: which is not good news if you enjoy the vibrancy of variability in the built world.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢建筑世界中多样性的活力，这可不是什么好消息。

sentences.en: Houses of differing styles, that's another thing that gives us a sense of place.
sentences.zh: 不同风格的房子，这是赋予我们地方感的另一件事。

sentences.en: You can tell that you're somewhere else because all the houses are different.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出你身处异地，因为所有的房子都不同。

sentences.en: But the sort of sprawl aesthetic is that it's the same everywhere.
sentences.zh: 但那种城市扩张的美学就是到处都一样。

sentences.en: And, you know, houses and styles didn't evolve through a planning committee.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，房屋和风格并不是通过规划委员会演变而来的。

sentences.en: They evolved through a combination of popular taste and place.
sentences.zh: 它们是通过大众品味和地域的结合演变而来的。

sentences.en: Like, that's why you'll see, like, Pueblo-style architecture in the West,
sentences.zh: 比如，这就是为什么你在西部会看到普韦布洛风格的建筑，

sentences.en: but you're not going to see it in Cary, North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 但在北卡罗来纳州的卡里却看不到。

sentences.en: It's just one of those things that gives you a context of where you are
sentences.zh: 这正是赋予你所处环境背景的事物之一，

sentences.en: and that the built environment has everything to do with place
sentences.zh: 建筑环境和自然环境一样，

sentences.en: as the natural environment does.
sentences.zh: 与地方有着千丝万缕的联系。

sentences.en: Embedded in the pages of McMansion Hell are lessons in consumerism and materialism.
sentences.zh: “麦克豪宅地狱”的页面中蕴含着消费主义和物质主义的教训。

sentences.en: But fundamentally, Kate Wagner picks apart these crimes against architecture
sentences.zh: 但从根本上说，凯特·瓦格纳以极其滑稽和痛苦的细节

sentences.en: in hilarious and excruciating detail
sentences.zh: 剖析了这些建筑罪行，

sentences.en: to teach us the fundamentals of architecture in a new way.
sentences.zh: 以一种新的方式教我们建筑的基本原理。

sentences.en: Using humor to educate people about the world around them
sentences.zh: 利用幽默来教育人们了解周围的世界，

sentences.en: is sort of a great way to get people involved in the sort of greater design community.
sentences.zh: 是让人们参与到更广泛的设计社区中的一种好方法。

sentences.en: Most people, what they learn about architecture in school
sentences.zh: 大多数人在学校里学到的建筑知识，

sentences.en: is they learn, like, the Greek orders.
sentences.zh: 就是希腊柱式。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, this is the Ionic column.
sentences.zh: 就像，哦，这是爱奥尼柱式。

sentences.en: Yes, this is the Flying Buttress.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是飞扶壁。

sentences.en: Everyone snickers.
sentences.zh: 大家都窃笑起来。

sentences.en: And it's really dry.
sentences.zh: 而且真的很枯燥。

sentences.en: People, like, really don't care.
sentences.zh: 人们，怎么说呢，真的不在乎。

sentences.en: I firmly believe that people do care.
sentences.zh: 但我坚信人们是在乎的。

sentences.en: Even if we don't know why, even if we don't know how to articulate it,
sentences.zh: 即使我们不知道原因，即使我们不知道如何表达，

sentences.en: we feel the effects of bad design,
sentences.zh: 我们都能感受到糟糕设计带来的影响，

sentences.en: whether we consciously notice it or not.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否有意察觉到它。

sentences.en: So now people can say, now I know why I hate that house.
sentences.zh: 所以现在人们可以说，我现在知道为什么我讨厌那栋房子了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Now it's like, wow, actually, none of these windows match.
sentences.zh: 现在人们会觉得，哇，说真的，这些窗户根本不搭。

sentences.en: I hate that.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌那样。

sentences.en: And it's empowering people to have opinions about the built environment,
sentences.zh: 这让人们有能力对建筑环境发表看法，

sentences.en: which they have mostly been served through, like,
sentences.zh: 而他们过去大多是通过，比如，

sentences.en: a marketing or materialistic lens,
sentences.zh: 营销或物质主义的视角，

sentences.en: rather than from a design standpoint.
sentences.zh: 而不是从设计的角度来看待这些环境。

sentences.en: And as I've learned with pointing out the bad design of city flags,
sentences.zh: 正如我在指出城市旗帜设计糟糕时所学到的，

sentences.en: once you get people to notice bad design,
sentences.zh: 一旦你让人们注意到糟糕的设计，

sentences.en: your annoyance spreads like a virus.
sentences.zh: 你的烦恼就会像病毒一样蔓延。

sentences.en: I get a lot of emails, like, and a lot of messages that say, like,
sentences.zh: 我收到很多邮件，还有很多信息说，比如，

sentences.en: before I read this blog, I didn't give two craps about architecture.
sentences.zh: 在读这个博客之前，我根本不在乎建筑。

sentences.en: And now I start to notice these things on all of the buildings I pass by.
sentences.zh: 但现在我开始注意到我经过的所有建筑上的这些问题。

sentences.en: And that makes me so happy because now other people have to suffer
sentences.zh: 这让我非常高兴，因为现在其他人也必须忍受

sentences.en: through what I have suffered for years and years and years.
sentences.zh: 我多年来一直忍受的那些东西。

sentences.en: And we will all suffer together.
sentences.zh: 我们将一起忍受。

sentences.en: There are bad houses and our ugly flags
sentences.zh: 有糟糕的房子，有我们丑陋的旗帜，

sentences.en: and doors that you don't know whether to push or pull
sentences.zh: 有你不知道该推还是该拉的门，

sentences.en: and our light switches.
sentences.zh: 还有我们的电灯开关。

sentences.en: You never remember which light they go to,
sentences.zh: 你永远记不住它们对应哪盏灯，

sentences.en: even though you've lived in the house for 20 frickin' years.
sentences.zh: 尽管你在那房子里住了整整20年了。

sentences.en: And our terrible currency,
sentences.zh: 还有我们糟糕的货币，

sentences.en: and our ugly passports,
sentences.zh: 还有我们丑陋的护照，

sentences.en: and our comic sans,
sentences.zh: 还有我们的Comic Sans字体，

sentences.en: and our public bench armrests,
sentences.zh: 还有我们公共长椅的扶手，

sentences.en: and our bogus expiration dates,
sentences.zh: 还有我们虚假的过期日期，

sentences.en: and our confusing ballots.
sentences.zh: 还有我们令人困惑的选票。

sentences.en: That one we really need to fix.
sentences.zh: 那一个我们真的需要修复。

sentences.en: Like, soon.
sentences.zh: 比如，尽快。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Katie Mingle,
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》的成员有Katie Mingle，

sentences.en: Kurt Colstead,
sentences.zh: Kurt Colstead，

sentences.en: Sharif Youssef,
sentences.zh: Sharif Youssef，

sentences.en: Sam Greenspan,
sentences.zh: Sam Greenspan，

sentences.en: Avery Truffman,
sentences.zh: Avery Truffman，

sentences.en: Emmett Fitzgerald,
sentences.zh: Emmett Fitzgerald，

sentences.en: Taryn Mazza,
sentences.zh: Taryn Mazza，

sentences.en: Delaney Hall,
sentences.zh: Delaney Hall，

sentences.en: and me,
sentences.zh: 以及我，

sentences.en: Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: Roman Mars。

sentences.en: All the music this week was composed by Sean Rial.
sentences.zh: 本周所有的音乐都由Sean Rial创作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced on Radio Row
sentences.zh: 在Radio Row制作，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.en: So last week I presented at the Frontiers Conference organized by the White House.
sentences.zh: 上周我在白宫组织的“前沿会议”上做了演讲。

sentences.en: President Obama was there and it was a very cool event.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统也在场，那是一个非常酷的活动。

sentences.en: I volunteered my time and I got myself out there.
sentences.zh: 我志愿贡献了我的时间，并积极参与其中。

sentences.en: And as a thank you for my effort,
sentences.zh: 作为对我努力的感谢，

sentences.en: the White House organizers gave me a presidential challenge coin,
sentences.zh: 白宫的组织者给了我一枚总统挑战币，

sentences.en: which as you can imagine, was a very big deal to me.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这对我很重要。

sentences.en: The 99% Invisible challenge coins are all gone.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》的挑战币已经全部发完了。

sentences.en: But for this year, for the fundraiser,
sentences.zh: 但今年，为了筹款活动，

sentences.en: we decided to design new Radiotopia challenge coins
sentences.zh: 我们决定设计新的Radiotopia挑战币，

sentences.en: to give to all the people who've stayed with us as regular donors for the last year
sentences.zh: 送给所有在过去一年里一直作为定期捐赠者支持我们的朋友，

sentences.en: as a token of our appreciation
sentences.zh: 作为我们的一点心意，

sentences.en: and offer them to new backers who want to get on board
sentences.zh: 并提供给想要加入的新支持者，

sentences.en: and keep our show going strong.
sentences.zh: 让我们的节目保持强劲的发展。

sentences.en: Having one of these coins means that you're committed to Radiotopia
sentences.zh: 拥有一枚这样的硬币意味着你致力于让Radiotopia

sentences.en: being the home of independent producer-driven podcasts.
sentences.zh: 成为独立制作人驱动型播客的家园。

sentences.en: And when you challenge me with a coin,
sentences.zh: 当你用硬币向我发起挑战时，

sentences.en: that means you're part of a family of people that makes this all possible.
sentences.zh: 那意味着你是让这一切成为可能的大家庭的一员。

sentences.en: Plus the new coin just looks awesome.
sentences.zh: 而且这枚新硬币看起来真的很棒。

sentences.en: I can't wait to get one myself.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想自己也拿一枚。

sentences.en: Go to Radiotopia.fm to become a coin-carrying Radiotopian.
sentences.zh: 前往Radiotopia.fm，成为一名携带硬币的Radiotopian。

sentences.en: If we add 5,000 donations to the roles,
sentences.zh: 如果我们能增加5000笔捐款，

sentences.en: FreshBooks, who make cloud accounting software,
sentences.zh: 制作云会计软件的FreshBooks公司，

sentences.en: particularly designed for independent creative people like me,
sentences.zh: 专门为像我这样的独立创意人士设计，

sentences.en: will donate $40,000.
sentences.zh: 将捐赠4万美元。

sentences.en: But we need you to make that challenge.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要你来完成这个挑战。

sentences.en: And I mean you.
sentences.zh: 我是说你。

sentences.en: Go to Radiotopia.fm.
sentences.zh: 前往Radiotopia.fm。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到这个节目并点赞。

sentences.en: All of us are on Twitter, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都入驻了Twitter、Instagram和Spotify。

sentences.en: But to find out more about this story,
sentences.zh: 但要了解更多关于这个故事的信息，

sentences.en: including cool pictures and links,
sentences.zh: 包括酷炫的图片和链接，

sentences.en: and listen to all the episodes of 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 以及收听《99% Invisible》的所有剧集，

sentences.en: you must go to 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你必须访问99pi.org。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
